A FEW USEFUL DETAILS

Before you
join the flow.

Is this a live inference service?+

This Site introduces the working MVP and replays recorded execution data in your browser. The FastAPI, PostgreSQL, scheduler and GPU services have a separate deployment path. No job submitted here reaches a GPU or incurs a charge.

How does prepaid billing work?+

The API reserves a maximum charge at admission, captures actual verified completed usage, and releases unused credits. The recording uses synthetic rates and mock byte-based usage, not measured Qwen token counts or a public GPU price.

What happens when a worker fails?+

Requests use expiring leases, worker generations and fencing epochs. The scheduler recovers abandoned work with bounded retries. Physical inference can repeat; unique accounting records and fenced finalization prevent duplicate capture.

What is needed for real GPU execution?+

Explicit spending approval, approved NVIDIA capacity, a pinned vLLM/model deployment, protected worker enrollment, and end-to-end validation. Provisioning is disabled by default. The source includes the deployment and verification instructions.
